ops_guidance.label: Hour of Day (Rush Hours)
ops_guidance.insight: Demand peaks sharply at 7-9 AM and 5-7 PM on working days, 4-6x higher than overnight. SHAP importance: 0.47.
ops_guidance.action: Pre-fill downtown docks before 7 AM. Run a reverse rebalance before 5 PM to empty them for returning riders.

ops_guidance.label: Working Day vs. Weekend
ops_guidance.insight: Commute peaks disappear entirely on weekends; leisure demand spreads across 10 AM-6 PM instead. SHAP importance: 0.26.
ops_guidance.action: Maintain two schedules: commuter (Mon-Fri, focus on office/transit hubs) and leisure (Sat-Sun/holidays, focus on parks/waterfronts).

ops_guidance.label: Hour Cyclical Pattern (sin_hour)
ops_guidance.insight: The smooth cyclical hour encoding reveals demand rises steeply from 5 AM and fades from 7 PM. SHAP importance: 0.19.
ops_guidance.action: Set rebalancing dispatch triggers at 4:30 AM (before the steep rise) and start the evening wind-down sweep at 7 PM, not midnight.

safety_buffer_note: Highest model error occurs at 7–9 AM (rush hour). Maintain a 15–20% spare-dock buffer at high-traffic stations during these hours.
